page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically running on an Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. The lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a tradeoff, positioning this server strictly for memory-intensive compute tasks rather than local-storage-heavy or graphics-accelerated workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory density makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring significant RAM without the overhead of excessive CPU cores. It is designed for memory-intensive applications such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing pipelines that fit within a 96 GB memory footprint.
